Custom Table extending Task with an extension hierarchy consisting entirely of Custom Tables; not Starter-eligible and cannot be grandfathered.

Grandfathered Custom Tables may be used for any permissible purpose on a production instance according to the prevailing contract in effect. They are allocated once on migration from a legacy product including App Engine Starter tables. Allocation eligibility is limited to tables created before the migration contract date and used to extend out-of-box workflows; Direct Task Inherited Tables are ineligible. Eligibility is considered in earliest sys_created_on order up to the grandfather entitlement limit. entitlements: Each exempt base table may be extended up to 1000 times: cmdb_ci, cmn_location, cmn_schedule_condition, dl_matcher, kb_knowledge, ml_cluster_detail, sc_cat_item_delivery_task, sc_service_fulfillment_step, scheduled_data_import, sf_state_flow, sys_auth_profile, sys_dictionary, sys_hub_action_type_base, sys_import_set_row, sys_report_import_table_parent, sysauto, syslog. Beyond 1000 requires App Engine or a product with Starter entitlement.

Exempt types: many-to-many registered in sys_m2m.m2m_table (at most 3 custom fields beyond system fields); dictionary-marked remote tables; ar_ tables created by platform archiving; rotated shards listed in sys_table_rotation_schedule; dynamically created application tables marked document tables.
Starter tables and exempt tables each have a 50 custom-field ceiling, subject to the specific 3-field many-to-many restriction.
Production custom tables require explicit assignment to App Engine or express custom-table entitlement from another purchased product.
